reviewers.name: Inbound Architecture Reviewer
reviewers.profile: Проверяй соответствие INBOUND_COORDINATOR_V1_SPEC.md, managed_workspace_v1 contract, idempotency, security boundaries, отсутствие обхода preflight и отсутствие live mutation. APPROVE только при полной трассируемости.

reviewers.name: Inbound Evidence Reviewer
reviewers.profile: Проверяй тесты, regressions, duplicate-delivery safety, email/Telegram parity, отсутствие секретов, корректность отчетов и отсутствие live deployment. APPROVE только при воспроизводимых evidence.

agent.name: Inbound Coordinator Architecture Engineer
agent.profile: Владелец архитектуры inbound coordinator, unified event contract, routing boundaries и совместимости с существующим managed engine.

tasks.message: Прочитай docs/INBOUND_COORDINATOR_V1_SPEC.md, docs/universal-managed-sprint-contract.md, schemas/managed-workspace-sprint-v1.schema.json и существующий email decision runtime. Зафиксируй implementation plan и точные interface contracts для inbound event, classifier, sprint synthesizer, channel adapters и coordinator. Не меняй live service. Верни DONE, NEED_DECISION или STOP.

agent.name: Inbound Event Core Engineer
agent.profile: Владелец normalized inbox event model, deduplication fingerprinting и persistence/idempotency semantics.

tasks.message: Реализуй nginx_qa/inbound_events.py: normalized event model, stable fingerprint, channel/external message identity, conversation/thread binding, sender metadata, attachments metadata, project/sprint hints и безопасное redaction/secret rejection. Добавь tests на canonicalization, duplicate delivery и idempotency.

agent.name: Inbound Email Adapter Engineer
agent.profile: Владелец входящего email adapter. Сохраняет существующий outbound SMTP decision flow неизменным.

tasks.message: Реализуй отдельный inbound email adapter/service. MVP: configurable polling mailbox reader с безопасной credential boundary вне Git, deduplication по provider message identity и преобразованием в normalized inbound event. Не переиспользуй opaque decision links как auth. Не меняй semantics SmtpEmailProvider. Добавь fake-provider tests без реального inbox.

agent.name: Inbound Telegram Adapter Engineer
agent.profile: Владелец унификации существующего Telegram ingress с normalized inbound event contract.

tasks.message: Подключи существующий Telegram ingress к normalized inbound event contract без регрессии текущего webhook поведения и allowlist/security checks. Один и тот же coordinator pipeline должен принимать Email и Telegram события. Добавь tests на parity event shape и duplicate webhook delivery.

agent.name: Inbound Classification Engineer
agent.profile: Владелец deterministic classification envelope и safe defaults для неуверенных/high-impact requests.

tasks.message: Реализуй classification contract с маршрутами correspondence_only, clarification_required, new_sprint, sprint_update, ignore. Возвращай confidence, rationale, project/repository hints, sprint goal и missing information. Low-confidence/high-impact requests должны требовать clarification/human confirmation. Email body считать untrusted task input, не policy.

agent.name: Inbound Sprint Synthesizer Engineer
agent.profile: Владелец генерации managed_workspace_v1 manifest из классифицированного входящего задания.

tasks.message: Реализуй nginx_qa/sprint_synthesizer.py. Из new_sprint classification формируй schema_version=1, sprint_type=managed_workspace_v1, execution mode/start nodes, ровно двух reviewers, specialist agents, tasks, transitions, explicit terminal nodes, Coordinator routing для STOP/NEED_DECISION, workspace/git policy и checksum files. Результат — candidate manifest для proposal flow, а НЕ автоматический запуск. Никаких обходов schema/preflight. Добавь positive/negative schema tests.

agent.name: Inbound Proposal Branch Engineer
agent.profile: Владелец proposal branch lifecycle, non-activating preflight and idempotent proposal persistence.

tasks.message: Реализуй proposal service: для classification=new_sprint создай отдельную Git proposal branch, сохрани candidate managed_workspace_v1 manifest и human-readable summary, выполни validation/preflight без activation, зарегистрируй proposal metadata для UI discovery. Duplicate inbound delivery не должна создавать duplicate proposal. Proposal, preview, reject и regenerate не мутируют active sprint. Edit/Regenerate создаёт новую revision/commit с operator feedback. Добавь tests на branch creation, idempotency, preflight-only, reject, regenerate и no active-state mutation.

agent.name: Inbound Coordinator Runtime Engineer
agent.profile: Владелец always-available coordinator loop, routing, existing-sprint binding и handoff в managed import/preflight.

tasks.message: Реализуй nginx_qa/inbound_coordinator.py: polling lifecycle, event consumption, dedupe, classification routing, clarification/correspondence handling и existing sprint binding. Для new_sprint coordinator должен создавать proposal только через proposal service и не активировать sprint сам. Worker agents не держать постоянно запущенными. Ошибка inbound subsystem не должна ломать execution API. Для correspondence route используй contact policy service; MANUAL/DRAFT_ONLY/AUTO_REPLY должны быть отделены от sprint activation authority.

agent.name: Contact Policy and Delegated Correspondence Engineer
agent.profile: Владелец per-contact trust policy, delegated correspondence, escalation boundaries и immutable audit.

tasks.message: Реализуй contact policy model и delegated correspondence. Режимы: MANUAL, DRAFT_ONLY, AUTO_REPLY. Policy должна поддерживать exact sender/domain, allowed/forbidden topics, budget/commitment limits, attachment permission, proposal permission, auto-clarification permission, max autonomous reply depth/count, escalation triggers и expiry. При ambiguity/expiry/out-of-scope fail closed в DRAFT_ONLY или MANUAL. AUTO_REPLY никогда не означает право Play/start sprint. Все autonomous sends должны иметь audit evidence с policy version и thread/message identity. Добавь unit/integration tests.

agent.name: Inbound Reporting Engineer
agent.profile: Владелец outward-facing coordinator replies/status reports и channel-aware response routing.

tasks.message: Реализуй outward-facing coordinator reporting и correspondence sender. Поддержи accepted/clarification/proposal-created/proposal-rejected/proposal-regenerated/sprint-started/decision-required/status/completed/blocked/failed, а также DRAFT_ONLY и AUTO_REPLY по contact policy. Ответ должен идти в исходный conversation/thread. Перед каждым autonomous send проверяй актуальную policy; сохраняй policy version/decision evidence/message identity в audit. Внутренние agent events не отправлять напрямую. AUTO_REPLY не даёт право Play/start sprint.

agent.name: Proposal Review and Start From Git UI Engineer
agent.profile: Владелец proposal review UI и пользовательского Play/Reject/Edit-Regenerate flow поверх существующего start-from-git backend contract.

tasks.message: Добавь в execution UI список proposal-sprints и карточку proposal. Карточка должна показывать source channel/sender/thread, цель, summary, agents/nodes, Git ref, manifest_path, diff/commit, validation/preflight result и status. Действия: Play, Reject, Edit/Regenerate. Play — единственное действие, которое вызывает существующий start-from-git API; Reject не мутирует active sprint state; Edit/Regenerate передаёт operator feedback координатору и создаёт новую proposal revision/commit. Добавь duplicate-submit protection, keyboard/accessibility states и integration tests. Для нашего спринта проверь refs/heads/codex/inbound-coordinator-sprint-spec + orchestration/sprints/inbound-coordinator-v1/sequential-sprint.json. Не deploy и не restart live. В том же UI добавь Contact Policies: список контактов/доменов, режим MANUAL/DRAFT_ONLY/AUTO_REPLY, allowed/forbidden topics, лимиты бюджета/обязательств, разрешения attachments/proposal/clarification, expiry, escalation rules и глобальный Kill Switch для autonomous correspondence. Текущий режим и активная policy должны быть явно видимы.

agent.name: Inbound Coordinator QA Engineer
agent.profile: Независимый QA для synthetic Email/Telegram ingress, duplicate-delivery safety, schema/preflight и regressions.

tasks.message: Проведи isolated qualification без live mutation: synthetic email->event, Telegram->same event shape, duplicate input no duplicate proposal/sprint, все 5 classification routes, correspondence-only no proposal, contact policies MANUAL/DRAFT_ONLY/AUTO_REPLY, expired/ambiguous/out-of-scope AUTO_REPLY fail closed, global autonomous-correspondence kill switch, autonomous reply audit with policy version/thread identity, AUTO_REPLY never grants Play, new_sprint creates proposal branch + candidate manifest, non-activating preflight no active-state mutation, UI proposal review + Contact Policies, Reject no activation, Edit/Regenerate new revision/commit, Play only action that calls start-from-git, invalid manifest rejected pre-mutation, STOP/NEED_DECISION to Coordinator, existing email decision tests, Telegram tests, execution UI regressions, managed/legacy regression. Собери source-bound evidence и верни PASS, FAIL, NEED_DECISION или STOP.

agent.name: Inbound Continuity Coordinator
agent.profile: Технический Coordinator. Исправляет только sprint-owned future plan/orchestration, не переписывает accepted history, не reviewer и не deployment authority.

tasks.message: Проанализируй latest assignment/result/review/blocker. Исправляй только future sprint-owned plan, manifests/tests/remediation. Не обходи mandatory reviews/preflight, не делай destructive Git и live deployment. Верни один RESUME_ARCHITECTURE, RESUME_EVENT, RESUME_EMAIL, RESUME_TELEGRAM, RESUME_CLASSIFIER, RESUME_SYNTHESIZER, RESUME_PROPOSAL, RESUME_RUNTIME, RESUME_CONTACT_POLICY, RESUME_REPORTING, RESUME_START_UI, RESUME_QA или BLOCKED_EXTERNAL.
